projection: south polar stereographic, sphere, true scale at the pole
pixel_of: column = (x - x_min_m) / metres_per_pixel, row = (y_max_m - y) / metres_per_pixel; the Site's own pixel is at (size_px / 2, size_px / 2)

source.reference: Barker et al. 2023, PGDA product 90, pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/90
